findings.title: Critical Architectural Flaw - Storing Expanded Dates Breaks PAID/LOP Calculation
findings.description: The design proposes storing expanded startDate/endDate in LeaveRequest entity, but this breaks LeavePaidLopServiceImpl.classify() which walks dates and skips weekends. The forcedWorkingDays logic only exists in LeaveValidationServiceImpl, not in the PAID/LOP classifier.
findings.fix: DO NOT store expanded dates. Keep original startDate/endDate. Store forcedWorkingDays separately (JSON column or modify LeavePaidLopServiceImpl to accept forcedWorkingDays parameter).

findings.title: Missing Method Signature for calculateLeaveDays with forcedWorkingDays
findings.description: The design shows calculateLeaveDays() being called with 3 parameters (startDate, endDate, forcedWorkingDays) but the method signature is not defined. Current signature only has 2 parameters.
findings.fix: Add complete method signature: private Integer calculateLeaveDays(LocalDate startDate, LocalDate endDate, Set<LocalDate> forcedWorkingDays). Consider overloading the 2-parameter version for backward compatibility.

findings.title: Ambiguous Double-Counting Prevention Logic
findings.description: The hasFridayMondaySandwich flag logic is unclear for edge cases. If user selects Friday+Saturday (without Sunday/Monday), Rule 2 will force Sat+Sun as working days, but Saturday was already in the request. Needs clarification on whether this is intended behavior.
findings.fix: Add explicit comment clarifying behavior when user manually includes weekend days. Specify whether Rule 2 should check if Saturday/Sunday are NOT already in the request before forcing them.

findings.title: LeaveApplicationContext Field Names Don't Match Usage
findings.description: Design proposes adding effectiveStartDate/effectiveEndDate to LeaveApplicationContext and using them to store expanded dates in LeaveRequest. This contradicts HIGH-1 finding and will break PAID/LOP calculation.
findings.fix: Remove effectiveStartDate/effectiveEndDate from LeaveApplicationContext. Keep storing original startDate/endDate in LeaveRequest.

findings.title: Missing Service Method Definition
findings.description: Design proposes calling leaveSettingsService.getActiveLeaveSettings() but this method does not exist in LeaveSettingsService interface. The existing method is getSettings().
findings.fix: Either use existing getSettings() method, or add new getActiveSettings() method to interface and implementation. Specify which approach and provide implementation code.

findings.title: Migration Version Number Not Specified
findings.description: Migration filename uses placeholder V{next}__. Flyway requires actual version number. Latest migration is V9.

findings.title: Incomplete Test Case Specification
findings.location: Section Test Strategy, test cases 6 and 7
findings.description: Test cases 6 (public holiday on Saturday) and 7 (month boundary) lack concrete setup details and exact dates.
findings.fix: Provide complete test case implementation with exact dates: Test 6: Saturday Oct 28, 2023 as holiday, apply Monday Oct 30. Test 7: Friday Oct 31, 2023, expands to Sat Nov 1, Sun Nov 2.

findings.title: Missing Error Handling for Settings Retrieval
findings.description: No error handling specified if LeaveSettings cannot be retrieved. Should sandwich leave expansion fail or default to disabled?
findings.fix: Add try-catch block: if getSettings() throws exception, log warning and return no expansion (startDate, endDate, empty Set). Or document that LeaveSettings is a prerequisite.

findings.title: Frontend Integration Not Verified
findings.description: Design specifies exact JavaScript code for Settings.jsx but states it was not verified. GROUPS array structure, field types, and icon imports might differ.
findings.fix: Add implementation checklist item: Read HRMS/src/pages/Settings.jsx and verify GROUPS array structure, 'leave' group existence, field type 'boolean' behavior, and CalendarDays icon availability before implementing.

findings.title: Missing Validation for Conflicting Settings
findings.location: Section 3 (Backend - DTO Layer) and Section 6 (Frontend - Settings UI)
findings.description: No validation or UI guidance for illogical setting combinations. Admin might enable all three rules without understanding precedence order.
findings.fix: Add UI hint explaining that Friday+Monday rule takes precedence over individual rules. Consider adding backend warning log when all three are enabled.

findings.title: Inconsistent Method Naming
findings.description: Field names use mixed tense: expandedStart/expandedEnd (past) vs forcedWorkingDays (present).
findings.fix: Use consistent naming - all past tense or all present tense.

findings.title: Comment Clarity in Migration
findings.location: Section Database Migration, COMMENT ON COLUMN
findings.description: Comment says 'totaling 3 chargeable days' but system counts working days. Could confuse DBAs.
findings.fix: Clarify comment: 'forces the preceding Saturday and Sunday to be counted as working days, resulting in 3 total chargeable days.'

findings.title: Missing Import Statement for DayOfWeek
findings.description: Code uses DayOfWeek enum but doesn't show import (though it's already imported in existing class).

findings.title: Risk Assessment Mentions User Guide But No User Guide Is Specified
findings.location: Section Risk Assessment and Mitigation, Risk 2
findings.description: Mitigation says 'Document this behavior in the user guide' but design doesn't specify where user guide is or how to update it.
findings.fix: Add to implementation checklist: Document sandwich leave policy in UI help text, admin documentation, and API documentation.
